description: You can follow allocation and cleanup for a local array, a heap integer, and a heap array.

steps.description: The function defines x and a fixed-size array as local objects. Their lifetimes end with the function's scope.
new allocates the integer 99. The code reads through p, releases the allocation, and then sets p to nullptr.

steps.answer: delete[] buf matches the array allocation.
steps.question: Which cleanup form accompanies new int[1024]?

steps.description: The buffer is zeroed before buf[0] is assigned 7. The array is released after that value is printed.
main calls the demonstration. Its supplied output shows heap int: 99 and buf[0]: 7.

title: Compare local and heap storage
